blocks.html: The city of Cebu is considered as one of the fastest growing cities in the Visayas region. With many people wanting to stay in the city for its highly urbanized lifestyle and rich history, the need for rapid real estate development surges high. Leading property developer, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), began to mark its presence in Cebu City by presenting the Azalea Place, Galleria Cebu Residences, and AmiSa Private Residences, three of its newest realty developments, to those who want to find the right place to live in the city. The Azalea Place, located along Gorordo Avenue in Lahug district, provides the residents ease of access to the city's tech hub and centers of learning, as well as government agencies. Residents will take joy in viewing the panoramic sight of the skyline as seen in their respective units. Galleria Residences Cebu offers the widest range of leisure activities to enjoy. Each of its three towers offer varying lifestyle amenities for the residents. Tower 1 is all about leisure where residents can spend quality time with their families. Tower 2 is for the sports enthusiasts as they enjoy an active and exciting day. Tower 3, on the other hand, is purely for rest, relaxation, and recreation for residents to unwind from a busy work life. Over at the historical and stunning seascape of Mactan Island stands the AmiSa Private Residences. Filipinos and foreigners alike will enjoy their stay in their units because of the holiday ambiance it gives off perfect for that dream day off. Also, its proximity to the Mactan International Airport is a convenience especially for travelers who just want to take a break from the hustle and bustle of city life. With all these exciting developments from Robinsons Land, locals and tourists don’t need to worry about finding a good place to live in as they enjoy their stay in Cebu City, the Queen City of the South.
